title: Ridge versus sparsity under a stated convention
promptMarkdown: For z=(3,0.4,−2), minimise J₂(w)=½||w−z||²+(λ/2)||w||² and J₁(w)=½||w−z||²+λ||w||₁ with λ=1. Derive the solutions including the subgradient condition at zero. Calculate each fitted vector and its unpenalised half-squared residual loss. Explain what changes if the L2 penalty is writtenλ||w||² without½.
hintLadder: Use a subgradient interval at the L1 corner.
Keep the penalty coefficient convention explicit.
